headline: The line at the gate has faces now
lede: Papers, Please-MIN's queue was a combinatorial hum: same parts, re-rolled. The booth now wears the original's one-off crowd — flat caps, fur ushankas, headscarves, a thick unibrow, a gold earring, a missing tooth — deterministic by passport number, painted at the counter AND in the passport photo, and proven (32 mutants say so) that no hat is ever evidence.

notes.text: One-off looks are derived from the entrant's serial — your number decides your hat, so the whole week replays byte-identical and face and photo can never disagree. Four regulars got authored decor: Grubak cap+unibrow, Marko earring, Anja scarf+gap-tooth, Petr ushanka over his big ears.

paperscheck 12842/12842 with 32 mutants all dying (m31 flattened crowd, m32 decor-read-as-evidence); papersplay 62/62 pixel-proves hat ink 1732px, unibrow 56, earring 9, tooth 30 at the counter and hatted photos carrying their hat.

Also today on the main line: FROGGER's proven crossing driver (WATCH b25), the LodeRunner live-chain, BRITANNIA storms endangering the hull, and the PAPERS-MIN ARC — one regular per week turns wanted and it is the wall, not the paper, that convicts.

look.text: Walk the new crowd at the border — hats and all — and spot Grubak in his cap
